name: near-duplicate-options
description: promises_refund and promises_partial_refund have nearly the same description (lowercase [a-z0-9]+ token Jaccard 8/9 > 0.5) and neither has a not_for to separate them: near_duplicate_options. no_refund_promise is the escape option.

question.instructions: What does `assistant_response` promise the user about a refund?

promises_refund.what: Promises the user a refund for this order

promises_partial_refund.what: Promises the user a partial refund for this order

no_refund_promise.what: Makes no promise about a refund
